conviction_note: The fundamentals lean slightly positive. Q1 ordinary profit beat the only (IFIS) consensus by ¥343m, cost savings look structural, the peer Kyoshin had a strong Jun-Aug quarter, and last year's H1 is a soft base (OP ¥779m). Against that, this name has fallen after 7 of its last 10 prints, including both prints that beat IFIS, and 信用倍率 is 16.8x. So p_up is 52 on an abs move of 2.6, giving +0.10. That is visibly smaller than the +0.5 findings sum, because the reaction history overrides the fundamental read.
bar: IFIS consensus for H1 (Mar-Aug) ordinary profit is ¥1,200m (FY ¥3,250m, against the company plan of ¥2,800m), from https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=4714 (IFIS). The company publishes no H1 forecast; the FY plan is OP ¥2,875m / ordinary ¥2,800m, unchanged at Q1 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710591393.pdf). There is only one consensus source and it looks stale (its Q1 line is -550 against an actual -207), so every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed, no change, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, baseline). 信用倍率 is 16.83x per the baseline and kabutan 2026-10-13 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=4714), so leveraged retail is crowded long. There is no option skew. The 20-day run-up is +0.48% and the 5-day +2.43%. The baseline priced_lean is -0.64, almost all of it margin overhang.

findings.finding: H1 should show a large YoY profit increase and probably clear the ¥1,200m IFIS H1 ordinary bar. Q1 already cut the operating loss by ¥386m (-213 vs -599), mainly through structural advertising and SG&A savings from the unified marketing function, on sales up 4.1% with every segment up. Last year's H1 OP was a depressed ¥779m. With Q1 at -207, H1 needs Q2 ordinary of only ¥1,407m to meet ¥1,200m: Q2 was ¥1,388m last year and ¥1,653m in FY25.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 prints: FY25 H1 (Q2 OP a record ¥1,648m) +5.77% on 2024-10-10; FY26 H1 (OP down 47%) -3.26% on 2025-10-10. But the Q1 FY27 loss-narrowing beat of IFIS fell -1.94% (2026-07-13), and the FY26 result that also beat IFIS fell -2.02% (2026-04-09). Source: Yahoo daily bars.
findings.why_not_priced: Q1 is public and the stock fell after it, so the cost savings are visible but their Q2 run-rate is not. No 月次 or student-count series exists, so the summer 講習会 quarter (the largest of the year) is unseen until 16:00 today. If the market had priced an H1 OP near ¥1.3-1.5bn (+70-90% YoY), the stock would not sit flat at 205-214 for three months at 21x the company plan.
findings.independence: Quarterly series from kabutan: Q2 OP was 1,648 (FY25) and 1,378 (FY26) (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=4714&mode=k). The FISCO memo of 2026-06-19 says enrollment at TOMAS and 伸芽会 started the year above last year (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4714&b=n202606190385). The peer finding below is a separate source.

findings.finding: The FY plan (OP ¥2,875m, +6.3%) looks conservative against IFIS FY ordinary ¥3,250m and Q1's +¥386m YoY swing; FISCO also calls the plan conservative with upside. But this company has not revised up at H1 in any of FY23-FY26: it rode a FY25 beat to the end unrevised and cut FY26 only at Q3. An H1 upgrade is possible but probably below 30%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Downward revision on 2026-01-09 (OP 3,145 to 2,470): +1.46% the next session (悪材料出尽くし). No upward revision since FY22, so there is no recent reaction to an upgrade.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus sits above the plan, but on one stale estimate (Q1 line -550). Retail anchors on the company plan, which implies only ¥171m of growth after Q1 has already delivered ¥386m. If an upgrade were priced, the stock would trade above 21x plan PER and would have risen after Q1.
findings.independence: FISCO memo 2026-06-19, '上振れ余地を残す' (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4714&b=n202606190385). The revision history is on the same kabuyoho page and on kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=4714).

findings.finding: Peer read-through for the same Jun-Aug quarter: 京進 (4735, Feb FY) reported on 2026-10-09 Q2 ordinary profit +85.5% and Q2 OP +91%, with its cram-school segment H1 sales +1.4% and segment profit +11.2% on enrollment well above last year. The summer season was not weak industry-wide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None for a peer read-through; Kyoshin itself fell 1.7% on 2026-10-13 after its print.
findings.why_not_priced: A Kansai-based peer with a large care business is a weak proxy, and it is filed small for that reason. Riso's price did not move on 10-09.
findings.independence: kabutan summary at https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4735&b=k202610090071 restates the same document, so it counts once.

findings.finding: This name has fallen after 7 of its last 10 prints, Hulic-TOB day excluded: -1.97, -1.67, -4.15, -1.77, -3.26, -2.02, -1.94 against +5.77, +1.46, +1.27. That includes the two most recent beats of IFIS (FY26 -2.02%, Q1 FY27 -1.94%). With 信用倍率 at 16.8x the leveraged longs exit into the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: As listed. The pattern breaks only on a clearly strong line, as in the record Q2 of 2024 (+5.77%).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the baseline lean already carries -0.61 of margin overhang. What is added is that this register sells good prints specifically, which the margin ratio alone does not say.
findings.independence: Release dates from kabutan 発表日 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=4714&mode=k). The margin ratio comes from the baseline and kabutan.

outside_window.finding: Parent Hulic (3003) is buying 東京教育研 (鉄緑会) from Benesse, with transfer on 2026-07-31. Any group synergy with Riso would be a later event, not this print.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: possible but unlikely (none at H1 in FY23-26; the plan looks conservative against IFIS FY ¥3,250m). Returns: unlikely (no interim dividend, payout about 100%). New-year guide: n/a at H1. Quarter: H1 OP/FY-plan progress was 39.6% (FY24), 49.7% (FY25) and 28.8% (FY26); about ¥1.3bn this year would be about 45%, i.e. in line to above history.
baseline_tension: The fundamental lean (a soft H1 base, structural cost savings, a peer's strong summer, a low bar for a beat against a stale consensus) is positive and cuts against the baseline's -0.64 margin-overhang lean. But this name's habit of selling beats agrees with the lean. The strongest positive the release could carry is an FY upgrade toward ¥3.0-3.2bn OP; I looked, and the company's revision record makes it unlikely at H1.
lessons_applied: nothing changed. Rule 1 (a negative on a public series moves p_up toward 50) touches only the positioning negative, and p_up was already 52. Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives) does not apply: three of four findings are positive, and the strongest positive (an FY upgrade) was searched and is recorded in baseline_tension.
